evidenceOwner.inputs: anticheat-simulation MovementValidationResult projected by anticheat-core ValidationEvidenceMapper into evidence ValidationRecord

evidenceOwner.dependencyDirection: evidence -> model (+ replay-schema allowed); core -> evidence + simulation; platform -> core; no cycle; no Bukkit/NMS/Netty in evidence

evidenceEvent: PASS (immutable; id = SHA-256 content digest without time; typed families from the raw Phase 8 reasons; magnitude = proven excesses with bound kind; proof summary and provenance retained; no candidate graph)
proofRequirement: PASS (EvidenceEvent.check/from: INVALID + proof present + exhaustive (hypotheses > 0, enumerated > 0) + 0 candidates remaining + all 13 dimensions + no uncertainty + no legal candidate/explaining hypothesis + no witness + NO_LEGAL_INPUT + every timing hypothesis complete; each variant tested)
invalidToEvidence: PASS (one deduplicated event per complete INVALID)
deduplication: PASS (content digest identity; DUPLICATE for re-delivery; OUT_OF_ORDER for late re-delivery; 512-id ring)
branchDeduplication: inherent (one event per transition proof; the Phase 8 INVALID already is the exhausted union)
sessionIsolation: PASS (new SessionKey -> new runner/ledgers; SESSION_MISMATCH for foreign records; digest includes the session)
worldEpochSegmentation: PASS (epoch change segments: run and groups restart, older-epoch events leave the active view, totals kept)
windowModel: PASS (30 s correlation/active window from the latest ingested monotonic time; sequence ordering; no wall clock)
expiry: PASS (deterministic from the records' own times; expired events stay in history and totals)
decay: NOT APPLICABLE BY SPEC (EVIDENCE_MODEL defines no decay function for this stage; none invented)
continuityModel: PASS (currentRun/longestRun: VALID, UNCERTAIN, rejected INVALID and epoch change end a run; DUPLICATE neither extends nor ends; patterns III/IVI/IUI/VIV/UIU/IIVVI pinned in window-results.json)
evidenceFamilies: HORIZONTAL_EXCESS, VERTICAL_EXCESS, IMPOSSIBLE_ASCENT, IMPOSSIBLE_DESCENT, COLLISION_PENETRATION, UNEXPLAINED_DISPLACEMENT, GENERAL_MOVEMENT_IMPOSSIBILITY - one-to-one from the Phase 8 invalid reasons, raw reasons preserved
magnitudeModel: PASS (typed horizontal / vertical excess + penetration flag with the Phase 8 bound kind; group = maximum member, never a sum; only complete INVALID residuals)
evidenceSnapshot: PASS (immutable, bounded, no verdict field; describe() <= 24 neutral lines)
p8f2ClimbableSafety: PASS (UNCERTAIN [CLIMBABLE_CONTACT] -> UNRESOLVED, zero positive evidence; ledger/property tests, live ladder)
p8f5SearchLimitSafety: PASS (UNCERTAIN [SEARCH_LIMIT] -> UNRESOLVED, zero positive evidence; the two legitimate-corpus cases included)
internalErrorSafety: PASS (INTERNAL_ERROR records -> gap; mapper/ledger exceptions contained, counted, no evidence)
metamorphicTests: PASS (VALID/UNCERTAIN streams -> 0; one INVALID -> 1; twice -> 1; INVALID + uncertainty -> history kept, no new evidence; session reset -> fresh; same stream -> same snapshot and events)

memory.bounds: events <= 256, groups <= 128, dedup ids <= 512, gap records <= 32, supporting ids <= 16; window 30000 ms; no per-player unbounded history, nothing keyed by UUID beyond the session map

P9-F1.originatingComponent: Phase 5 attribute model (anticheat-physics) with Phase 6/7/8 consequences
P9-F1.failure: the server-synced minecraft:sprinting MOVEMENT_SPEED modifier was read as the client modifier set, so every candidate of a tick on which a moving client stops sprinting was 30 percent too fast; one complete false INVALID and one positive evidence event on a legitimate player (live seq 235287->235357, residuals 0.02940 and 0.05978)
P9-F1.fix: PhysicsState.sprintModifier class (FOLLOWS / STUCK_ON / STUCK_OFF / MAYBE_STUCK_ON / MAYBE_STUCK_OFF), snapshot-agnostic attribute resolution, lazy member split in InputReconstructor, class bit mask in AbstractState/AbstractTransfer, snapshot resynchronisation and anchor classes in MovementValidationRunner, applying sequence recorded in MovementContextLedger.AttributeValue
P9-F1.requalified: yes, on the final jar: 9800 live transitions with explicit sprint-stop patterns, 0 occurrences of this class
P9-F1.reattribution: the two Phase 8 P8-F2 live observations (same 0.02940 residual at the ladder) were this defect; Phase 8 documents and artifacts remain frozen and unchanged

P9-F2.originatingComponent: Phase 3/8 world knowledge (NOT Phase 5: the step is bit-exact against the real server, and NOT the search: the forensic candidate table and the prefilter-off differential both exclude it)
P9-F2.failure: a block state the client and this observer disagree about - the client applies its own predicted block change immediately and moves against it, while the authoritative state reaches this observer only with the chunk broadcast; symmetrically a change this observer applied reaches the client one transport delay later. The model proved transitions impossible against a shape the client was not using (live: an oak trapdoor held open here, closed on the client - step-up 0.1875 blocked, COLLISION_PENETRATION; and an edge back-off against a ledge the client did not have)
P9-F2.fix: BlockDisputeLedger (per session, shard-owned, 256 cells / 64 pending, overflow degrades to a whole-world dispute) + additive MovementValidationRequest.worldDisputed -> MovementValidator sets worldOk=false with UncertainReason.WORLD_INCOMPLETE for any transition whose reach region touches a disputed cell
P9-F2.ackOrdering: ClientboundBlockChangedAck is sent from the interaction handler before ChunkHolder.broadcastChanges, so the acknowledgement does NOT settle a predicted cell - only the applied change or the 3s horizon does (the first build settled on the ack and a live failure got through)
P9-F2.regression: BlockDisputeTest (4): the live failure reproduced offline, the gate result, no weakening away from the dispute, ledger bounds/ack ordering/horizon
P9-F2.requalified: 6321 live transitions on the fixed jar: zero INVALID of this class, the gate fired 15-16 times per round where the failures used to occur (7 UNCERTAIN [WORLD_INCOMPLETE]); a place-then-walk control past the horizon produced 1215 clean transitions

P9-F3.originatingComponent: Phase 5 input pipeline (sneak scaling timing) and Phase 8 rest anchoring
P9-F3.failure: captures 3/5/6: a sneak-scaled step the model attributed to the wrong tick, and a resting sneaker anchored STANDING (clipped under a top slab)
P9-F3.rootCause: pinned 26.2 client LocalPlayer.aiStep assigns crouching from isShiftKeyDown() before ClientInput.tick(): the sneak scaling of tick T follows the key of T-1 (= the pose the tick starts in), pose and edge back-off read the fresh key; restFixedPoint probed every pose with a shift-released input
P9-F3.fix: PhysicsSimulator scales by sneak iff the start pose is CROUCHING; AbstractTransfer transfers each start pose; restingInput(pose) keeps the crouching rest in the anchor union; the oracle harness corrected the same way
P9-F3.regression: RestPoseAnchorTest (5, 3 fail pre-fix), PhysicsCoreMatrixTest, InputReconstructorTest (assertUniqueUpToFinalSneak), AbstractTransferTest
P9-F3.verified: physicsNativeDifferential 88/88 scenarios 3105/3105 ticks bit-exact; landing matrix 4005 ticks bit-exact; legitimate corpus 32451/0 INVALID

P9-F4.failure: captures 4 (local) and 9 (VPS, a death): after a login/respawn the client sent tick ends without moving, then a normal first step; the model simulated the frozen ticks and declared the first step impossible
P9-F4.rootCause: pinned 26.2 client: handleLogin/handleRespawn clear clientLoaded; LocalPlayer.tick returns while it is false; Minecraft.tick sends ClientTickEnd, then ClientPacketListener.tick sends ServerboundPlayerLoaded and sets the flag
P9-F4.fix: PacketEngine signals JoinGame/Respawn (clientLoadReset) and the PLAYER_LOADED lifecycle packet (clientLoaded); MovementValidationRunner leaves the tick ends in between out of the physics slice; a position after a frozen tick drops the anchor (never a verdict)
P9-F4.regression: ClientLoadedTicksTest (3; the old handling reproduces the live INVALID)
P9-F4.requalified: deaths and a cross-dimension teleport in the final live run, 0 INVALID

P9-F5.originatingComponent: P8-F3 entity relevance (anticheat-player) and the Phase 8 context mapper (anticheat-core)
P9-F5.failure: capture 7: an airborne tick needed 0.0381 horizontal impulse vs 0.0255 max (a rabbit pushing); capture 8: from rest, 0.0604 backward vs 0.098/0.0294 (a nearby mob pushing) while the tracker reported 0 entities
P9-F5.rootCause: (1) 26.2 ClientLevel.getPushableEntities returns the local player for every other entity, so every remote living entity pushes the local player, while P8-F3 tracked players only; (2) vanilla sends every entity spawn inside ServerEntity.addPairing ClientboundBundlePacket and ContextObservationMapper ignored bundles, so no spawn ever reached the tracker live
P9-F5.fix: EntityClass.PUSHER with an exact NON_PUSHERS set pinned against the jar (95 pushers, 41 non-pushers, 21 hard colliders, 1 player; unknown types are pushers); ContextObservationMapper maps bundle children in wire order
P9-F5.regression: EntityPushClassificationTest (3), NativeSemanticTest.aBundledNativeSpawnReachesTheNeighbourhoodTracker, MovementContextLedgerTest bundle case, MovementValidationRunnerTest rabbit case (bundle tests fail pre-fix)
P9-F5.precisionCost: transitions within 4 blocks of an animal/mob are UNCERTAIN ENTITY_NEIGHBORHOOD_UNKNOWN
